about_the_game:
Destroyer Valkyrie takes to the heavens under space Commander Dart Norman in this sci-fi-themed DLC. In addition to the British ship and Commander, you’ll warp away with Sci-Fi Space camouflages, a week of Warships Premium Account, and the Spaceship patch symbol.

This package contains:

  • Tier III researchable British destroyer Valkyrie

  • British Commander Dart Norman with 3 skill points

  • 7 days of Warships Premium Account

  • 1 Sci-Fi Space permanent camouflage

  • The Spaceship patch symbol


The content of this DLC will be invoiced on your Wargaming Account only once.
